The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms & Conditions: 1. Name of the Manufacturer, Brand Name (If any), Composition and Strength of the product, Rate, and GST/HSN Co de details must be mentioned clearly in the bid documents. 2. The payment shall be made against the bill as per Aligarh Muslim University rules. 3. The rate must be quoted in Indian rupees and F.O.R. JNMC Hospital, Aligarh 4. Arbitration: If any difference arises concerning this agreement, its interpretation on payment to the made there under, the same shall be settled out by mutual consultation and negotiation. If attempts for conciliation don’t yield a ny result within a period of 30 days, either of the parties may request to the other party for submission of the dispu te for decision to the sole arbitrator i.e., Vice-Chancellor, AMU, Aligarh, or his nominee. The decision of the sole arbit rator shall be binding on the parties. The venue of the arbitrator will be at Aligarh. 5. Breach of Terms and Conditions: In case of breach of any terms and conditions as mentioned above, the Comp etent Authority will have the right to cancel the Purchase order without assigning any reason thereof and nothing wil l be payable by J.N. Medical College Hospital, AMU, Aligarh, in that event the security deposit shall also stands forfei ted. 6. ution or making of any order for winding up, whether voluntary or otherwise, or in the event of the firm failing to co mply with any of the conditions here in specified, the Medical Superintendent, J.N. Medical College Hospital, AMU, Ali garh shall have the power to terminate the contract without any prior notice. 7. Bidder shall submit a copy of the tender document and addenda thereto, if any, with each page of this document should be signed and stamped to confirm acceptance of the entire terms &conditions as mentioned in the tender enquiry document. 8. Signed & stamped compliance sheet of the technical specifications for the goods must be enclosed. 9. Conditional bids shall be rejected. 10. Applicable Law: The contract shall be governed by the laws and procedures established by the Government of India within t he framework of applicable legislation and enactments made from time to time concerning such Commerci al dealings /processing. Any disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Competent Court and Forum in Aligarh, Uttar P radesh, India only. The Arbitration shall be held in accordance with the provisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, and the venue of the arbitration shall be at Aligarh. The decision of the Arbitrator shall be final and binding on both parties. 11. The Bidder/Seller should submit a notarized Undertaking on an affidavit of Rs. 100/- (Indian Non-Ju dicial stamp) Undertaking must be obtained after the bid publishing date. · The bidder has not quoted the price higher than the current financial year and last financial year supplied to any go vernment Institute/Organization/reputed Private Organization, OEM also has to submit that the price quoted by the bidder in the bid is on its behalf and the lowest in the current and last financial year in the country. Therefore, if at any stage it has been found that the supplier / OEM have quoted lower rates than those quoted in this bid; the Instit ute (the purchaser) would be given the benefit of lower rates by the Supplier and any excess payment if any, will be come immediately payable to the Institute (the purchaser). · All drugs supplied will meet the IP/USP/BP standards, and the packaging will comply with the tender's logogram an d labeling specifications. · Undertaking regarding logogram: To print “HOSPITAL SUPPLY NOT FOR SALE” as per the tender's packaging gu idelines. · I/We have read, understood, and agreed unconditionally to the terms and conditions of the bid · I/We declare that I/we have never been blacklisted/debarred by any State Government/Central Government or any State/Central PSU during the last 05 years. · I/We hereby confirm and declare that, Firm nor any of its directors/Proprietors are not under liquidation, court recei vership, similar proceedings, bankrupt, or abandoned any work for the Central/State Govt. /Semi Govt. / PSU/Autono mous body.

· I/We hereby confirm and declare that there is no ongoing criminal case/vigilance enquiry/labor dispute against the company or its owners/directors, and have never been convicted by any Hon’ble Court of law or any other authority (Central/State Govt. Dept.) If such an affidavit is not submitted, the bid will be out rightly rejected. (Part of technical bid). 12. Bidder should have a valid Drug License, and it should be attached to the tender document. Otherwise, the te nder will be rejected. 13. The Authorization Certificate of OEM should be specific toJ NMCH SUPPLY. It should be in the name ofT he Me dical Superintendent, JNMCH, AMU, ALIGARH- 202001 14. Bidder should be a Manufacturer or authorized dealer/distributor of theO EM. 15. Bidder must submit: Valid Drug License/Import License (If imported), PAN, GST, ISO-9001: certificat e & (CDSCO)/COPP (Certificate of Pharmaceutical Product) or WHO-GMP certificate. Make in India certifi cate, Last 3 years market standing certificate, Non-Conviction certificate, valid NABL accredited lab tes t report. 16. Rate, packing & manufacturer’s name should be mentioned clearly in the offer. 17. Inspections, Testing and Quality Control: All the batches of the drugs/medicines supplied must be accompanied by an In-House Test Report/Certi ficate of Analysis (ATR) from the manufacturer on Quality Control Lab. 18. Buyer’s Right to Test: Buyer reserves the right to conduct stringent quality checks to ensure that drugs/medicines need the r equired specifications. The buyer reserves the right to carry out necessary inspections/tests from NABL Accredited/Government Laboratories at Pre-dispatch, Receipt, or during Shelf Life. 19. If any item is found to be substandard on physical examination (viz. Appearance, packing, etc.) or fails the stan dard Analysis Test, the entire defective batch must be replaced without extra cost. 20. Offers of bidders, which do not conform to the specification, unit /packing size of items of the indent, will not be considered for acceptance. The offer of the bidder for such items shall be rejected. 21. A copy of PAN, GST registration should be submitted with the tender document. 22. MSME/ Startup benefits will be given to the manufacturer only. MSME / Startup benefits to the Distributor or Dea ler should not be entertained. 23. The manufacturer / OEM should have a turnover of 400% or more then 400% of Bid value of Medicine manufact uring in the last Financial Year. The bidder should submit documentary proof. 24. Last three years of market standing certificate in the supply of the listed medicines. 25. A valid undertaking certificate under the Make in India policy should be submitted. 26. Pricing: · The bidder must quote the unit price of each drug item listed in the tender as per the format provided.

· Prices must be quoted in Indian Rupees (INR) and inclusive of all charges such as customs duty, packaging, for warding charges, transportation, and insurance, inclusive of GST. · Prices should be quoted per unit size as mentioned in the BOQ tender, and any deviation may lead to disqualif ication. For example, if the tender specifies 10x10 tablets, the price should be quoted for that quantity and not for a single tablet. · Any variation in the unit sizes or packaging must be highlighted and justified. · The prices quoted in the financial bid should be valid for 365 days from the date of submission. · In the event of price reductions during the validity period, the bidder must pass on the benefits to the purchasi ng authority. 27. Packaging: · All medicines must be supplied in a standard individual carton packing. · Injectable vials or ampoules should be in a Blister/Mono Carton Box pack. · Outer cartons must mention Generic name, Strength, Pack size, Batch number, Manufacturing date/Ex piry date, Storage Conditions, and Quantity. 28. Logogram: “HOSPITAL SUPPLY NOT FOR SALE ” must be printed indelible ink on each primary container an d outer carton. 29. Labels: All labels as per Drugs & Cosmetics ACT 1940. Generic Name in bold, Manufacturing/Expiry date/Batch on both primary and outer packing 30. Shelf-Life: Minimum 75% of shelf life must remain at the time of supply product with <18 months expiry will b e rejected. o 31. Cold Chain: Cold chain items must be supplied at 2-8 with temperature data logger. 32. Delivery: 100 % supply within 15 days of supply order partial supply not accepted unless prior written permissio n. 33. Replacement: Expired/defective/substandard medicines must be replaced free of cost within 15 days. 34. Post-delivery quality testing: · The buyer reserves the right to test the samples from each batch of supplied drugs. · If any batch fails quality testing, the supplier will be required to replace the entire batch at their own cost. · A penalty will be imposed if the quality of medicines does not meet the tender specifications as decided by the competent authority of the university purchase committee. .
